meaning:
φροντίζω
(φροντίς, thought), [in LXX: 1Ki.9:5 (דָּאַג), Psa.40:17 (חָשַׁב), al. ;]
to give heed, take thought (in cl. usually absol., with accusative, with genitive), with inf., Tit.3:8 (see Bl., § 69, 4; M, Pr., 206 f.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you affirm confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good…
